order_of_operations: 1. create the new boards (add-state-board.mjs) — they land in a measured free slot
2. author their content (apply-text-fixes.mjs against the cloned node ids, plus the new nodes named in each content spec)
3. wire them (add-hotspots.mjs — never wire-edges.mjs, which makes the whole board clickable)
4. ONLY THEN run brand-05-arrangement.json, so layout-section.mjs re-flows the section with the new boards already in it

content.title: Rename token ID
content.rules_line: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. No spaces.

validation_line.text: An ID with that name already exists.
validation_line.why: window.prompt validates nothing — an empty name, a duplicate id and a name with spaces all come back as-is (TokenDetailView.tsx:250-259)

impact_line.text: 34 elements are bound to this token and will be re-pointed.
impact_line.why: UX-H-31 — the usage breakdown is already loaded on the screen that opens this modal (TokenDetailView.tsx:134-155). The rename must show it.

kind_guard.text: Renaming isn't available for type and spacing tokens yet.
kind_guard.why: FIG-F-09 — rename is dispatched by kind; for TYPE and SPACING the call lands on `undefined?.()` and returns silently. A modal that pretends otherwise is the same lie window.prompt told, in a nicer box.

content.what_it_replaces: Replaces 34 colour, type and spacing tokens. Radius, shadow, motion, border, opacity, z-index, breakpoint, grid, sizing, icon and imagery keep their current values.
content.what_it_costs: 6 staged brand edits will be discarded, and per-token undo is cleared for colour, spacing and type. The only way back is the footer's Discard, which drops every staged change.
content.why: UX-H-30 + UX-H-35 — DesignSystemTab.tsx:562-578 handleDiscard calls discardAll() on every token AND preset registry, so 'let me just look at Linear Dark' costs whatever else was staged. This board is the what-will-change step UX-H-35 asks for in front of every whole-brand write.

board_edits.why: UX-H-35 names three doors that write the whole brand without showing what they replace: starters, import and AI. Starters is N4, import is N1. The AI door already has the right shape: FIG-F-32 read all four AI-prompt boards and found the success board correctly draws a schema PREVIEW and NO Accept button, because the modal's onAccept is optional and its only mount omits it. The propose → diff → apply → single-undo contract V2 §5 calls 'the one contract worth keeping' is already drawn here. The remaining AI gap is the FEATURE_DS_AI flag (useComposerInit.ts:132 gates the client, DesignSystemTab.tsx:890 does not gate the button) and that is carried by the AI lane, not this one.
